bullets.text: Public fear grew in Kattupakkam near Poonamallee after two dengue cases were reported in a single day, prompting the office to monitor health department vector control measures.
Garbage spilling over from a vacant plot in the Ambattur SIDCO industrial estate blocked access to three factories, and the office should coordinate clearance with local civic authorities.
Anna University campus placement job selections dropped by twenty percent due to the impact of AI, and the office should watch employment trends for engineering graduates.
MeitY Secretary stated that AI regulation papers are in their final stages and will be released shortly, and the office should review the upcoming national policy guidelines.
Thieves stole a server worth two crore rupees and ninety laptops from a Guindy IT co-working office in Chennai, and the office should monitor the police investigation.
DMK members staged a protest in Pattabiram and Avadi by hanging an effigy of TVK MLA Arul Vignesh upside down, and the office should monitor local political tensions.
Protesters in the Avadi district area targeted the TVK MLA over controversies, and the office should watch for further demonstrations in the constituency.
